text:
Maria (CS): Heads up — Catalyst onboarding has recurring tail latency spikes on long prompts and the renewal signal is soft. Proposing a proactive canary: 5% traffic -> quantized 7B model + split routing for non-critical requests. @Sam @Dinesh can you eyeball viability this week?
Sam (Backend Eng): Thanks Maria. Can you share concrete latency percentiles and an example prompt distribution? also any SLOs they care about?
Maria (CS): Quick numbers: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~940ms for 2k-5k token sequences, spikes when batch=1. Majority of calls are classification-style prompts. Customer priority: latency then cost, small quality regressions acceptable. Sample prompt (redacted): """Summarize the following policy text and return action items."""
Nora (Solutions Eng): Ran a small sim locally — int8 quant on our 7B candidate yields ~30% p95 reduction, cost ~40% lower. Saw minor score drift on 3/40 eval cases. Can do 5% canary to start.
Dinesh (SRE): If we route 5% to quant variant we need: autoscaler policy tweak, explicit fallback to original model, and a KV-prefix cache enabled (cache hit dropped in my sim). I'll add a canary autoscale rule and an alert on error-rate and latency regressions.
Sam (Backend Eng): Tech notes: confirm tokenization compatibility and that function-calling / structured outputs behave same. Need console rollout config + automatic fallback route in case error-rate > 1% or p95 degrades > 20%.
Maria (CS): Customer is comfortable with up to ~0.5 BLEU-equivalent drift for 48h if latency/cost improve. Proposed timeline: canary Wed 09:00 PT, 48h observation, expand to 25% if eval and user-facing metrics look good.
Nora (Solutions Eng): Draft traffic-split (for console/infra) — config below:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: primary
    model: redwood-7b-standard
    weight: 95
  - name: quant-canary
    model: redwood-7b-int8-v1
    weight: 5
fallback_policy:
  error_rate_threshold: 1.0 # percent
  p95_latency_threshold: 20  # percent degradation vs baseline
monitoring:
  eval_set: catalyst-core-samples-v2
  metrics: [p50, p95, token_cost, accuracy_delta]
```
Dinesh (SRE): I'll wire alerts: p95 > baseline *1.2 OR error_rate > 1% -> immediate rollback. Also adding tracing hooks for token-level latency breakdown.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout job scheduled by Sam — job_id=rbw-canary-5109876620, window=48h.
Sam (Backend Eng): I'll open PR with the rollout config + dashboard links (will include eval diffs and synthetic load checks). @Dinesh please review the alert thresholds.
Maria (CS): I'll capture this plan in the customer record and send Catalyst the preflight note + rollback criteria. Will collect feedback during canary and surface any qualitative drift.
Nora (Solutions Eng): If canary looks good we can recommend a staged quantization + routing playbook for their renewal deck (projected 35-45% cost savings).
Maria (CS): Great — thanks everyone. I'll ping again with the customer reply and any early metrics. :thumbsup:
